rules.statement: When a public API writes encoded or decoded bytes into a caller-supplied Span<byte> destination, also give it an overload that writes to an IBufferWriter<byte>, along with the method that tells the caller how big the destination must be.
rules.why: The maintainer asked for a buffer-writer overload alongside the span-only Decode method, so callers can write output without first sizing and allocating a destination buffer.
rules.check: Look for new public encode, decode or serialize methods that take only a Span<byte> destination and have no IBufferWriter<byte> overload, for example a generic `ref TWriter destination` where `TWriter : IBufferWriter<byte>, allows ref struct`.
